text:
emily-partnerships: Quick heads-up — we need to run a partner-facing compatibility dry run for the upcoming API/SDK change. Affects marketplace vendors, SI connectors, and a couple HW partners. Proposed week: Apr 7-9. Goal: validate migration docs, canary clients, and update marketplace listings.

sam-alliances: +1. Can we split by partner tier? Recommend pilot with 2 enterprise partners + 3 marketplace vendors before wider notice.

devin-sdk: What exactly is changing? lighter note: if it's just auth header rename and a small response envelope tweak we can add shims in the SDK for one release.

emily-partnerships: Right — two parts: 1) auth header name change (old: X-API-Key -> new: Authorization) and 2) we drop the nested result field in v4 responses (clients currently expect response.result -> now response). We want to avoid breaking SIs that parse envelopes strictly.

chandra-product: We should offer an opt-in canary flag on the hosted API for partner tenants so they can flip during the dry run. That will help debugging without hitting prod defaults.

devin-sdk: I can add an opt-in compat shim behind a feature flag, plus logs that surface when the shim is active. Timeline: PRs by Fri, test builds early next week.

mike-legal: Heads-up: any messaging about deprecation needs the 60-day notice for enterprise contracts. Please loop in customer success before wide comms.

emily-partnerships: Good catch Mike — we'll do partner-by-partner notices after the pilot. Internal checklist: 1) partner selection (Sam) 2) SDK shim + canary opt-in (Devin) 3) partner runbook and rollback steps (me + Chandra) 4) legal/comms review (Mike)

sam-alliances: I'll ping the two enterprise SIs (SigmaSI, NorthForge) and ask for a 2-hr window for a live test. Also will ask marketplace vendors to opt into the canary with a short form.

integrations-bot: canary-deploy started for tenant 'sigma-partner' (canary-flag=true) at 2432110005 — watch logs: /integrations/logs/sigma-partner

devin-sdk: Ran smoke on Sigma — auth header accepted, envelope normalization shim active. Found one issue: pagination cursor is still nested, pushing fix now.

emily-partnerships: Solid. Next steps: Sam to confirm partner availability, Devin to cut a hotfix for cursor normalization, Chandra & Mike to draft partner notice. I'll schedule a 30-min sync on Mon to review pilot results. :calendar:
